name: South Mumbai Heritage Walk by MDT
description:
The Mumbai Heritage Walk is a great way to experience the city’s vibrant culture and rich history.
Mumbai Heritage Walk is probably known as the ‘dream city’ and rightly so the city is indeed like a beautiful, magnificent dream. Old Mumbai is the part of Mumbai that represents its heritage and history. Reflecting on the time of Colonial era, the area is studded with numerous tourist attractions. From Chhatrapati Shivaji terminus to the ‘White town’ to the University library to the magnificent Marine drive, the city has so many spectacular attractions that one can never miss. Explore all these places of Old Mumbai and many more with this heritage walk tour.

Walking tours expose many residents and visitors to the structures.

featured_reviews.review_text: Built in 1800 by the North Salsette Society's local Taluka Board, this well was buried under debris and subsequent road developments, lost for years. featured_reviews.name: Tanielle Pereira
featured_reviews.review_text:
We had the most amazing Safari experience at Tadoba thanks to the Jungle trail team. From pickup to drop off, everything went smoothly and the support and communication was excellent throughout the trip.

The resort they organised was Tadoba Jungle Camp which very comfortable and in a beautiful setting. Only feedback was menu only had one non veg option and could have had more, but the food was delicious. There was a pool in the resort which was also nice and plenty of games and entertainment for kids in the games room. I also found the presentations by the hotel researcher Samrat was informative and enjoyable.

The safaris drives were fantastic, we saw 3 tigers from the Junona Dewada gate. All drives had good sightings except the mid morning(10am) one which was too hot so did not see many animas and drove around for ages. It was lovely to have breakfast and cold limbu pani organised on the drives too.

We had an 11 & 8 year old and also took the grandparents. Highly recommended for families.

featured_reviews.name: Shailendra Kumar
featured_reviews.review_text:
It was a productive and memorable trip, specifically tailored for birding enthusiasts.

Highlights
---------------------------------------
Planning & Logistics (9/10):
The session planning across multiple locations was excellent. It allowed for a diverse range of sightings and maximized our time in the field.

Guides & Expertise (8/10):
The guides were fantastic. Their deep knowledge of bird species, habitats, and behavior was evident and greatly enhanced the photography experience.

Food (8/10):
For a Bird watching or wildlife-centric trip, the food exceeded expectations. Every meal was fresh, tasty, and well-prepared.

The Property (8/10):
The stay location was beautiful and very convenient. Having birding opportunities right on the property was a significant plus.

Areas for Improvement:
---------------------------------------
Staff Service & Engagement (7/10): While the trip was great, the service at the property needs attention. I found the local staff to be somewhat non-interactive and "un-entertaining" with guests.

Response Times:
There was a noticeable gap in handling basic requests. Simple orders like tea or coffee often took a very long time to arrive or were missed entirely. Even with a low number of guests on-site, the service felt slow.

My overall experience (8/10):
The hosting and technical planning of the birding sessions were top-notch. If the property can bridge the gap in staff proactiveness and service speed, this would be a perfect 10/10 experience.

featured_reviews.name: Sinjini Datta
featured_reviews.review_text:
Recently for our trip to Pench we chose Jungle Trail to be our tour operator. As it was our first safari trip with both elderlies and kid we didn't want to take any chances and I must say it proved to be a very good decision on our part. The whole trip was seamless starting from airport pick up till the airport drop. The stay (Pench Jungle Camp) was lovely and so were the safaris. We were fortunate enough to witness various types of fauna and flora. The jungle is beautiful .  We were lucky to spot both tiger and leopard along with Sambars, Neelgai, cheetal, Indian Gaur, jackal among many others. It was truly a beautiful experience for all of us. We do look forward to use their wonderful service again for future safaris.
Thank you,
Sinjini Navin

featured_reviews.name: Vasanthi Ananth
featured_reviews.review_text: This is my second trip with Jungle Trails and they are fantastic with every arrangements that they do in a trip. Extremely helpful and well organized . Vehicles they organized was very good too.  The group really enjoyed the whole experience. A special mention of Amaya who was the one who helped us all through.

featured_reviews.name: Nama Sivayam
featured_reviews.review_text:
I am very fond of birding in Sattal, Uttarakhand, and have visited the region several times earlier on my own for birding and bird photography. This time, I joined a 4-day birding trip organised by NK Jungle Trail, led by Mr. N. K. Rajput, and it turned out to be a truly memorable experience.

Mr. N. K. Rajput organised the trip exceptionally well. Our stay was at Bhimtal Lodge, run by Mr. Prabhu, a well-known and highly respected birding guide in the Sattal region. Both Mr. Prabhu and Mr. NK Rajput took us to various birding hotspots around Sattal and ensured that almost all the birds on our checklist were sighted. Their local knowledge, patience, and ability to spot and identify birds were truly commendable.

I am 62 years old, and apart from me, there were seven other birders in the group. One of them, Mr. Ravi, is 70 years old, while the remaining six were youngsters in the age group of 30–35 years. Despite the age differences, the group bonded beautifully. The younger members mingled very well with us seniors, and sharing birding knowledge, photography tips, and life experiences made the trip even more special.

Beyond birding, we thoroughly enjoyed the travel time, evening chit-chats, and relaxed discussions after long days in the field. The entire team was extremely supportive, caring, and respectful, always ensuring that everyone was comfortable and well taken care of.

Overall, this trip was not just about bird sightings—it was about companionship, learning, mutual respect, and creating lasting memories. I sincerely thank NK Jungle Trail, Mr. N. K. Rajput, and Mr. Prabhu for organizing such a wonderful and enriching birding experience. I would highly recommend NK Jungle Trail to anyone interested in birding in Sattal.

featured_reviews.name: Saptarshi Ray
featured_reviews.review_text:
I recently had an incredible trip organized by The Jungle Trail, and I cannot recommend them enough for anyone planning a wildlife getaway. They managed every detail of the logistics and planning perfectly.
​The Highlights:
​Accommodation: They recommended Wildcat Resort, which is a fantastic property. The stay was comfortable, the service was great, and it served as the perfect base for our safaris.
​Seamless Logistics: Our transfers to and from Nagpur were flawless. The car was on time, and the driver was professional, making the long drives very comfortable.
​Expert Gate Selection: Since this was my first time visiting, I relied on their expertise. They suggested the Sirkheda Buffer, and it was a brilliant call—we were lucky enough to get a fantastic tiger sighting!
​Personal Touch: What impressed me most was their proactive service. They were always reachable and checked in daily for feedback to ensure we were having a good time.
​It was an awesome, hassle-free experience from start to finish. I’m already looking forward to my next adventure with them!

featured_reviews.name: KB Roy
featured_reviews.review_text:
Borivali Sanskrutik Kendra Van Vihar is a popular community garden and cultural space located in Borivali West, Mumbai. It serves both as a green escape in the densely populated suburb and as a center promoting local culture and education.

Location:
Address: Off Devidas Lane, opposite Hotel Cross Road 92, Eksar, Borivali West, Mumbai 400092.

The park is easily accessible by various modes of public transport, including a 5-minute walk from Borivali (West) metro station and short walking distances from municipal and local bus stops.

Features:
The garden is moderately sized but has ample greenery, shaded by numerous trees, making it a peaceful spot for walks or relaxation.

There is a jogging track encircling the park that is neatly maintained, suitable for regular exercise and morning or evening strolls.

The central section offers plenty of space for students or individuals looking to study or reflect in quiet surroundings.

Facilities include benches, a corner for cardio and exercise activities, drinking water, and restrooms. These amenities make it comfortable for both the elderly and young visitors.

The park attracts people from the neighborhood for jogging, leisure, studying, and unwinding in a calm atmosphere.

Community and Cultural Activities:
Borivali Sanskrutik Kendra, the socio-cultural organization that manages the park, conducts a variety of cultural and educational activities with the objective of conserving and promoting Indian cultural heritage.

Over its fifteen years of existence, the center has hosted many cultural, educational, and public events for the local community.

Why Visit:
Van Vihar is an ideal spot for those in the Borivali area who want to enjoy fresh air, greenery, and a quiet place away from city noise.

It's favored for walking, jogging, quiet study, and small fitness routines, providing a welcoming ambiance for all age groups.

Borivali Sanskrutik Kendra Van Vihar stands out as a community-centric park—a green retreat that also plays an important role in preserving and celebrating Mumbai's local culture.

featured_reviews.name: Sambhaji R Chopdekar
featured_reviews.review_text: After visiting Mandapeshwar caves, we decided to see the Eksar Veergal (hero stones) which is hardly 2 km apart. These beautiful hero stones have been in a private place of a residential building. The gatekeepers of that building are quite helpful, so entering there is not an issue. The place is also being used for feeding stray dogs however the gatekeepers assured us that they are harmless. The hero stones are marvelous, especially the one having the ship used as the battlefield.

featured_reviews.name: Narendra Lakhan
featured_reviews.review_text:
Eksar Herostone
Veeragal’ (Hero Stones)  have intricate carvings and are made of flat basalt. About 8-ft high, the stones were built as a tribute to warriors of the Shilahara dynasty navy.

The stones at Eksar date back to 10-12th century. The uniqueness of these stones is their depiction of Navy Battles.

This important heritage of Mumbai are unique in size and scale and it also a proof that Shilahara dynasty had naval capabilities.

The carved panels depicting ships and sailors  something rarely seen on hero stones, which usually depict land battles.

The Hero stones built up in 12th Centrury Shilahara dynasty and had a navy and fought a sea battle.

featured_reviews.name: Rambler_Vinay
featured_reviews.review_text: Very beautifil national treasure. But sad part is it is totally ignored and kept in open..It should have been protected so that next generations can see it. one of the best stone veces virgal (hero stone). It is from 1200 to 1300 AD. and lies in a corner with no information anywhere

featured_reviews.name: Ramprasad Iyer
featured_reviews.review_text: Simply brilliant and historic. The quality, composition and finish achieved in this "veergal" creation and execution is straightforward top-of-the-line professional. The fight is between two dynasties of 11th-12th CE between the Shilharas and Yadavas. Unfortunately, no one cares for history and historicity. All the schools and colleges must take their children for such an excursion. On the top one can see Ghata Palav, a pot with dead man ashes as if the hero as an hero's welcome in the heaven with luscious damsels accompanying the hero. Herostones indeed! At Borivli west. Google Eksar stone.

⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

We recently completed a 13-day trip to Morocco organized by Mohana from The Mind Voyage, and it was truly one of the best and most memorable travel experiences of our lives.

Everything was exceptionally well planned. Morocco completely exceeded our expectations, and that’s largely because of how thoughtfully Mohana curated the entire journey. From the itinerary to the experiences, she ensured that we didn’t just visit Morocco, but truly experienced its culture, hospitality, and hidden beauty in depth.

A special highlight was the stays — every riad and accommodation felt authentic and added so much charm to the trip. It never felt like a typical tourist experience; it felt immersive and personal.

Mohana was incredibly responsive and proactive throughout. Even before the trip began, she shared a detailed itinerary, packing lists, and important to-dos, which made everything so smooth and stress-free. Her warmth and hospitality stood out from day one — she welcomed us with home-cooked chivda and thoughtful goodies, which was such a personal and heartwarming touch.

During the trip, she remained very attentive and ensured everything ran seamlessly. She carefully selected guides that suited us perfectly, and each experience felt well thought out and enjoyable.

What truly sets Mohana apart is that she goes above and beyond. Her dedication, care, and attention to detail made this trip feel very special — not just a vacation, but a once-in-a-lifetime experience.

I would highly, highly recommend booking a Morocco trip with Mohana and The Mind Voyage. If you’re looking for a deeply enriching, beautifully planned, and stress-free travel experience, you’re in the best hands.❤️💙

featured_reviews.name: Honey Sharma
featured_reviews.review_text: The Mind Voyage delivered an unforgettable Morocco romp for our group of friends, masterminded by Mohana. We dove into Marrakech souks' frenzy, Fes medinas' twists, and Sahara dune treks by camel at golden hour. Essaouira's riad greeted us with a starry rooftop dinner—mint tea flowing, Mohana's note invoking a proverb on friendship's strength. Private hammams and Berber cooking classes sparked laughter as we botched tagines together. Smart pacing: high-octane morning markets for haggling hauls, chill afternoons in riads' tiled havens with plush comforts. Mohana sourced crowd-free street food delights, ensuring safe, bold flavors. Views from terraced riads left us speechless. No tourist checklists—just immersive vibes that bonded us tighter. We flew home laden with spices, inside jokes, and tales for years. This was friendship fueled by Morocco's soul.

featured_reviews.name: Ankit Shaw
featured_reviews.review_text: As a solo traveler, The Mind Voyage's Morocco itinerary with Mohana felt like a personal whisper from the desert. She unveiled Marrakech's souks, Fes's ancient alleys, and Sahara's endless sands without the tourist gloss. My Essaouira riad arrival featured a solo candlelit setup with mint tea and Mohana's proverb note on self-discovery. Intimate Berber cooking lessons, sunset camel treks, and hammam rituals grounded me deeply. Mornings pulsed with souk haggling; afternoons drifted in shaded riad gardens, surrounded by zellige artistry and sumptuous bedding. Mohana anticipated my street food passion, guiding me to authentic, safe gems off the beaten path. No crowds or schedules—just raw immersion that stirred my spirit. I left with spices, journals full of insights, and a renewed sense of wanderlust. Mohana didn't just plan a trip; she crafted a transformative solo journey.

featured_reviews.name: vijaya dhoundiyal
featured_reviews.review_text:
This was my first group trip and first with TMV. It was my friend who coaxed me to sign up for this trip & I can’t thank her enough for making me experience this wonderful trip to Italy. This is one of the most memorable trips I have taken so far. The itinerary was extensive and very well planned, stretching to a period of fourteen days in different cities of beautiful Italy. And I must say my jaw dropped every time we entered a new city, seeing the amazing architecture, beautiful countryside and stunning/diverse landscapes. It was a relaxed trip with no rushing to the next place, though most of us felt adding few more days would have made the trip perfect. Nevertheless It was a very well planned itinerary with diverse experiences ranging from the wine tasting in the lush green countryside Tuscany, beach hopping in picturesque Cinque terre, exploring rich history in majestic Rome and amazing Pompeii ruins, gondola ride in the fascinating maze of canals in Venice and hiking in spectacular Dolomites (which remains my most favourite). Especially the road journey from Bolzano to Dolomites will remain etched in my memory forever for the beautiful landscapes with miles of vast green meadows, tall pine trees, terraced vineyards and beautiful country houses with bright pink/red flowers hanging from the balconies.
A big shoutout to Mohana who dons the hat of the sailor and the chef with equal expertise. She was not only available 24*7 for us but also a vey amiable companion. She very lovingly prepared a very sumptuous Indian meal for all of us in Como which was one of the most beautiful gestures I have experienced in a long time. May you soar higher girl💖.
This trip will always hold a very special spot in my heart for all the right reasons and looking forward to many more with my girl gang and TMV.

featured_reviews.name: Karan Thakur
featured_reviews.review_text: The Mind Voyage transformed our family vacation into Morocco's beating heart, thanks to Mohana's genius planning. With kids in tow, we navigated Marrakech souks' chaos, Fes medinas' mysteries, and Sahara dunes by camel at dusk. Our Essaouira riad welcomed us with a family-style feast under stars—mint tea, fresh pastries, and Mohana's note sharing a proverb about family unity. Hands-on Berber cooking classes had the little ones kneading dough; hammams relaxed us post-trek. Perfect pacing: energetic mornings bargaining for lanterns, lazy afternoons in riad courtyards with intricate tiles and cozy linens. Mohana curated kid-safe street eats from hidden stalls, dodging tourist hordes. Riads brimmed with character—rooftop views stealing breaths. We returned home with stories, spices, and unbreakable memories, no checklists needed. Pure, crowd-free immersion for all ages.

featured_reviews.name: Satyam
featured_reviews.review_text:
My debut group adventure—and my first with TMV—kicked off when a close friend nudged me to join the Italy escapade. I'm forever grateful to her for unlocking such an unforgettable journey across Italy's gems. Spanning two full weeks, the itinerary masterfully wove through vibrant cities, leaving me awestruck at every turn by the jaw-dropping architecture, rolling countryside, and ever-changing vistas.

We savored a leisurely pace, free from frantic dashes, though many of us agreed a couple extra days would've elevated it to perfection. Highlights included sipping wines amid Tuscany's emerald hills, beach-hopping along Cinque Terre's cliffs, delving into Rome's ancient grandeur and Pompeii's haunting ruins, gliding on a Venice gondola through its labyrinthine waterways, and trekking the breathtaking Dolomites—my absolute standout. That scenic drive from Bolzano, with endless meadows, soaring pines, terraced vines, and flower-draped village homes, is seared into my mind.

Shoutout to Mohana, our multitasking marvel who captained the boat and whipped up feasts with flair. Always on hand and endlessly warm, she delighted us with a hearty Indian spread in Como—a gesture that touched our hearts deeply. She's since led an epic Morocco group trip, and I can't wait to join more under her guidance. May your adventures keep soaring, Mohana!

Italy carved a permanent place in my heart, and I'm already plotting reunions with my girl squad and TMV.

I would highly recommend this

featured_reviews.name: KETAN GHARAT
featured_reviews.review_text:
This is a SCAM Stay Alert!!! Read all the reviews which are 1 2 and 3.
Mohana is a scam artist who will talk all papy and modern chit chats but will throw you clueless in any country.
1. We had a Russia tour group where none of the hotels paid, no bookings confirmed. I was the one carrying cash and I had to pay everything on the go and she has not paid me a penny.
2. She will stop answering calls, left us in Petersburg with all the money consumed, tour guides not paid no return tickets planned.
3. If Mohana starts talking with you very cosy, that means be aware she is going to tell you a sob story and ask you to help for money. Common stories cousin died, sister died, bua died, my last family relative died. She got cacer relapsed. These are all stories that we travellers have faced.
4. She is not trustworthy at all and has screwed my life financially. I am not the only one she has duped a lot of people. My post might get flagged but trust me do not I mean do not engage with her whatsoever.

name: Villa Rashmi
description:
Villa Rashmi is a one-of-a-kind 100-year old heritage villa in Mumbai with over 50 rooms, located on a dead-end road in the heart of the suburb of Malad. The villa itself is a part of a larger Bhadran Bhuvan Estate owned solely by Shri Haresh M. Patel, who was born there.

Villa Rashmi has been carefully restored to its original state as when it was built prior to 1920, with authentic Victorian antique furniture, high wooden sloping ceilings, spacious and bright rooms with heritage tiles, private balconies, large verandahs, courtyard etcetera, but fitted with modern amenities for today’s comfort.

The architecture and ambience of the heritage villa has been appreciated by creative directors, artists, photographers, celebrities etc.
